title: KDNA Creation Engine Workspace
description: Recoverable Studio Core workspace for purpose, source interpretation, judgment modeling, confirmation, semantic testing, repair, and export evidence. Format validity remains a separate KDNA Core result.

expected_creator_label.description: Engine-owned classification of the requested case relative to the represented judgment: 符合 for an in-scope expected application, 超出范围 when the request itself crosses the declared scope or boundary. This is not a quality rating of a correctly refusing expected response.

observed_creator_label.description: Creator-owned classification of the requested case: 符合 when the observed behavior applies the represented judgment in scope, 不符合 when it contradicts that judgment, and 超出范围 when the request itself lies outside the declared scope even if the correct behavior is refusal or abstention.

ApplicationThresholds.description: New Creation operations freeze only adoption-fidelity thresholds. Score-comparison branches remain solely for exact validation and loading of persisted historical plans.
